sentences.en: The natural sciences are nomothetic, whereas the humanities are idiographic.
sentences.zh: 自然科学是规范性的，但人文学科是描述性的。

sentences.en: Type inference has three outputs whereas checking only has two.
sentences.zh: 类型推理有三个输出，而检查只有两个。

sentences.en: Potatoes grow in the ground, whereas apples grow on trees.
sentences.zh: 土豆长在地下，但苹果树上长着。

senses.zh: 鉴于,然而,反之n.“鉴于…”：正式文件的介绍性陈述，开场白,条件性陈述
